events.title: Void Skirmisher is part of Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hey pilots, Steam Next Fest starts today, and Void Skirmisher is part of it with its demo. Void Skirmisher is an arcade shooter in space. You play alone or online with up to seven others, fight enemy forces in every level until none are left, and every few levels a boss is waiting for you. What's in the demo The demo has the first 40 levels with five boss fights. Everything you earn in it carries over into the full game, which comes out on 3 December. events.title: Demo update: easier to find your way around the station
events.summary: Hey pilots, some of you told me the station was hard to read on your first visit. Max would trot off while you were still reading, and the dots on the radar didn't really explain where you could dock. Fair point. So I changed a few things. Every room shows where it is Each room on the station now has a glowing frame around its docking area. Fly into it and the room opens. The frame pulses gently while you're docked, so you always know where you are. Station labels Next to every frame there's now
